description.en: Open or search sites by keyword, with custom sites, icons and suggestions; no extra process
description.zh: 用关键词打开网站或搜索网页，可自定义网站、图标和搜索建议；不运行额外进程

notes.zh: 说明里补上：选中网站那一行按 Tab，关键词就补进搜索框（这是 Win顺 0.26.0 的功能）。插件本身没有变化。最低主程序版本为 0.25.0。
notes.en: Its guide now says that Tab on a site's row puts the keyword in the box (a feature of WinShun 0.26.0). The plugin itself is unchanged. Requires WinShun 0.25.0.
